limitations: Recomputed from copied before state and executed inputs; stored plan.expectedBoard ignored

Unknown attacks, spin, cancellation and external garbage are not scored as matches
Observed-rise consistency checks later display evidence; it is not a predicted full-board or server-order match
Interrupted replans, including HOLD recovery, are excluded from completed-lock and clear accuracy
A display-consistent record does not establish authoritative server fidelity
